title: AI Coat of Arms Generator
summary: Free AI coat of arms generator: describe your family, colours and symbols and get an original family crest, heraldic shield or engraved bookplate design.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free coat of arms generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every coat of arms on this page, costs 5 credits an image.


### How do I make a family crest with AI?


Describe the shield's colours and division, one main animal or object that means something to your family, and the helm, mantling and crest above it, then ask for a blank motto scroll and generate a few versions to compare.


### Can AI find the coat of arms for my last name?


An AI image model draws a new, original design from your description rather than looking up historical records, so for arms already recorded under your surname, check a heraldry society or archive first, then describe those arms to redraw them in any style.


### What symbols and colours are used on a coat of arms?


The classic colours are gold, silver, red, blue, green, black and purple, and common charges include lions, eagles, stags, foxes, towers, keys, stars, roses and simple bands such as the chevron, the bend and the cross.


### Can I add a motto to my coat of arms?


Yes. Ask for a blank scroll in the image, then set your motto on it in a design tool, which gives clean, correctly spelled lettering in the typeface you choose.


### Can I make a coat of arms for a fantasy story or game?


Yes. Describe an invented house, its sigil and the colours of its banners, then place the arms on shields, flags and seals in each scene, using the first image as a reference so the heraldry stays the same throughout.
